components.note: 子 (child) — children and offspring, as in 孙 grandchild, 学 study, 字 character; 孩 is a young child.
亥 (hài) is a close sound clue for hái; 亥 also sounds out 该 gāi, 核 hé and 刻 kè.
子 (child) — a picture of a baby with arms outstretched and legs bundled. As a suffix (孩子, 房子) it is a light noun ending.
走 (walk, run) — movement, as in 赶 chase, 超 surpass, 越 cross over; 起 is to rise or get up.
己 (jǐ) is a loose sound clue for qǐ; 己 also sounds out 记 jì and 纪 jì.
来 (come) — it began as a picture of a wheat plant; the sound was borrowed for "come". 麦 (wheat) still shows it, with a root 夂 added.
斤 (axe) — cutting tools, as in 新 new and 斩 chop. 所 once echoed the sound of chopping; "place" and "that which" are later borrowed uses.
此 (cǐ) is a loose sound clue for xiē; 此 also sounds out 紫 zǐ and 雌 cí. 些 is the plural-ish "some, a few".
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 过, 近, 送: 还 is to go back or return (huán), then "still" (hái).
不 here stands in for 睘 (huán) in the traditional 還, so it is not a real clue; same stand-in in 环 huán.
门 (mén, gate) is a close sound clue for wèn; the picture is asking at a gate, as in 闻 wén.
口 (mouth) — speaking, as in 吃, 唱, 叫: asking is a mouth action.
页 (head, page) — heads and faces, as in 头 head, 顶 top, 额 forehead; 题 first meant forehead, then "heading".
是 (shì) gives a loose sound clue for tí; 是 also sounds out 提 tí and 堤 dī.
廾 (two hands) — in 開 two hands lift the bar of a gate; 开 is the simplified shape. Compare 关 (close).
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈 mom, 好 good, 姐 sister.
台 (tái) is a loose sound clue for shǐ; the same 台 gives 治 zhì and 怡 yí.
门 (gate) — doors and openings, as in 问 ask, 开 open, 关 close.
日 (sun) — a gap in the gate lets daylight through (the traditional 間 had 月 moon): the space between.
工 (work) — a carpenter's tool shape: work, craftsman. 工 is a sound series: 红 hóng, 江 jiāng, 功 gōng, 空 kōng.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做: 作 is something a person does or makes.
乍 (zuò) gives the exact sound; 乍 also in 昨 zuó, 炸 zhà and 怎 zěn.
灬 (fire) — heat and burning, as in 热 hot, 点 dot, 照 shine. 然 first meant "to burn" (燃 rán adds 火 later); "so, naturally" is borrowed.
肰 (rán) gives the exact sound and shows up in 燃 rán.
后 (after, behind) — two words merged in simplified writing: old 后 "ruler" (皇后 empress) and 後 "behind, later" (as in 然后).
忄 (heart) — feelings, as in 快 happy, 怕 afraid, 忙 busy.
青 (qīng) is a close sound clue for qíng; the series 清 qīng, 请 qǐng, 晴 qíng, 精 jīng.
京 (jīng, high mound, capital) is a loose sound clue for jiù; going up to a high place fits 就 "to approach, to go to".
下 (below) — a mark placed under a line, the mirror of 上 above.
非 (not) — two wings spread in opposite directions, so "opposed, not". Gives sound to 啡 fēi, 排 pái and 悲 bēi.
巾 (cloth) — cloth and clothing, as in 布 cloth, 带 belt, 帽 hat; 常 first meant a long skirt (裳 cháng).
尚 (shàng) is a loose sound clue for cháng; 尚 also sounds out 堂 táng and 掌 zhǎng.
手 (hand) — over 目 (eye): a hand shading the eyes to look into the distance. 目 marks seeing words, as in 眼, 睡.
至 (arrive) — 到 is to arrive.
刂 is the knife form 刀 (dāo), a close sound clue for dào; 到 itself sounds out 倒 dǎo/dào.
亡 (wáng) is a close sound clue for wàng; it also sounds out 忘 wàng (forget) and 网 wǎng.
月 (moon) — to gaze up at the moon, so to look into the distance, then to hope.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢: giving permission is spoken.
午 (wǔ) is only a loose sound clue for xǔ.
朋 (friend) — oldest form shows two strings of cowrie shells (old money) side by side; they paired up and came to mean companions.
又 (hand) — two hands 又 stacked: hands joined in friendship.
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 她, 姐, 奶; 妈 is mother.
马 (mǎ) is a close sound clue for mā; also in 吗 ma, 骂 mà and 码 mǎ.
目 (eye) — looking; an eye turned on a tree 木, hence to look at, and mutually looking: "each other". 相 also gives 想 xiǎng, 箱 xiāng and 湘 xiāng.
亻 (person) — a person and his word: 言 (speech) beside it gives a person who keeps his word, hence "trust, believe".
言 (speech) — written 讠 on the left of other characters, as in 说, 请, 谢.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢; recognising something is naming it.
人 (rén) gives the exact sound, and also means "person".
儿 (child, legs) — shows a person's legs; in 兒 the top was a child's soft skull. As an ending (这儿) it adds the er sound; 儿 also in 先, 兄, 光.
今 (now, today) — gives sound to 琴 qín, 含 hán, 念 niàn and 吟 yín; the old picture is uncertain.
大 (big person) — a person with a line above the head, marking the sky above; tiān = heaven, sky, day.
日 (sun) — the sun beside the moon: two light sources, so bright and clear.
月 (moon) — as in 朋, 期, 有; here it brightens the night.
白 (white, bright) — gives sound to 拍 pāi, 怕 pà, 伯 bó and 泊 bó. Meaning: white, clear, plain, hence "明白" understand.
目 (eye) — sighting along a straight line. 直 also sounds out 值 zhí and 植 zhí.
土 (earth) — ground and place, as in 场 field, 城 city, 坐 sit.
也 (yě) is a loose sound clue for dì; 也 also sounds out 他 tā and 池 chí.
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 这, 近, 送: 过 is to pass or cross.
寸 here replaces 咼 (guō) of the traditional 過, so it is not a sound clue; 咼 survives in 锅 guō and 祸 huò.
发 (send out, hair) — two characters merged in simplified writing: 發 fā "emit, issue" and 髮 fà "hair" (头发).
回 (return) — a swirl or whirlpool drawn as nested squares: it turns around and comes back.
冫 (ice) — cold, as in 冷 cold, 冰 ice, 冻 freeze; here it stands for 氵 water in 準 (a water level, so exact).
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) gives only a loose sound clue for zhǔn.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打 hit, 拿 take, 把 hold; 找 is to search with the hands. The right part 戈 is not a useful clue.
